title: Choose the tracker composition
question: All three use the Benchmark Ledger direction. Choose the layout that should become the working app.

options.label: Expanded ledger
options.thesis: See all eight weeks at once, with the current week opening directly inside the ledger.
options.viewport: One full-width eight-row ledger; the current row expands into deliverables, proof, hours, and notes.
options.risk: The expanded row needs careful responsive reflow on narrow screens.

options.label: Week strip + work sheet
options.thesis: Use an eight-cell progress strip above one spacious active-week work sheet.
options.viewport: A compact eight-week strip sits above a three-column current-week sheet and a next-week preview.
options.risk: The week strip can become dense on phones and must collapse cleanly.

options.label: Indexed run sheet
options.thesis: Keep the eight-week index visible beside a task-first active run sheet.
options.viewport: A narrow week index anchors three large deliverable bands with integrated evidence fields.
options.risk: The index reads like a sidebar unless its ledger rules stay visually continuous.
